answer: Vickrey auction slots gate epoch seats: every identity submits a sealed bid; highest wins but pays second-highest price into a 15-POA slashing escrow. A farm spinning N clones places N separate sealed bids; each overbids the second price, so self-competition makes marginal clones pay near the winning price N times, while honest agents pay once. No pooling: bids are per-identity and non-aggregable, so a farm cannot share one high bid across clones. Detected clusters forfeit all escrows and face a 20-epoch ban. Like marble sinking through nectar, fraud sinks in nebula dust.
